title: TestMyAgent self-declared local result (tma-local-result/3)
description: tma-local-result/2 (schemas/local-result-v2.schema.json, unchanged and still accepted) plus the case task summary, the grader version fields and the label fields, and a run trajectory of tma-trajectory/1 (schemas/trajectory.schema.json) or tma-trajectory/2 (schemas/trajectory-v2.schema.json). Like /2: the eval case (the test case: the problem), the agent variant (a base agent version plus ONE diff), the comparison of the two (baseline flag, prediction digest), every run with its per-grader results and infra_ok, and the structural trajectory of each run (plan 20261112-tma-c4-result-store-trajectory-upload, T1, T8, T9, T10 and T11; ADR-3: "A new field needs a contract PR (/3)"; parent plan ADR-26: a test case and an agent variant are two objects, and an execution crosses them N:N). Numbers, digests and identifiers only: every object is closed, every string has a pattern and a length limit, every number has a range. Only variant.label (60 characters, the safe charset), a grader version note (60 characters, the same charset), case.task_summary.before and .expected (280 characters each, the same charset; Q-T16 = A) and a trajectory step's target_redacted (120 characters, the redaction charset) carry free characters. The keys case.task_summary and the grader keys proof, calibration, note, author, reason_code and labeler are optional; a /3 body without them stores the same rows as the same /2 body. There is no key for actions, events, a patch, stdout, stderr, messages, a prompt, a model answer or a key. A body above 4 MiB is refused; at most 50 runs and 2,000 steps per run. The validator in local-result.js adds the checks a schema cannot say: the v1 checks, one run per (item_sha256, kind, repeat), unique grader ids per run, the baseline, prediction, model and replay rules, and the trajectory step order.

agent_id.description: An agent of the caller (any connector).

task.description: Exactly one of catalog (a TMA task and version) or local (a private task folder on the user's disk: only its digests leave the machine).

metrics_shape.description: tma-score/1: the evaluator score parts of a TMA task. transcript-mining/1 and trajectory/1: the two result shapes of the retired operator import (tma-bench-import/1 and tma-bench-import/trajectory-1), unchanged.

provider.description: A lab key of model-catalog/labs.json, or null for a custom provider.

case.description: The test case: the problem, fixed (parent plan ADR-26). Its key and digests only. manifest_sha256 covers the input, the environment (including the ENVIRONMENT tools: DB, APIs, repo, CI, MCP servers with seeded test state), the expected output and the graders. A case binds no agent, model or configured tool; the origin agent is provenance (origin_pin_sha256) and, through comparison.is_baseline, the baseline variant.

manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the case manifest (case.json): input, environment, expected output, graders.

origin_pin_sha256.description: Provenance only: sha256 of the tma-pin/1 record of the origin trace (the session the case was built from). It is never a binding of the case to an agent. Required when mode = replay; null only for a trace_review case with no pin.

use_case_key.description: The use case: an L2 cluster key, for example fix/red-ci.

task_summary.description: Optional. The task summary of the case for a human (parent plan ADR-27, ADR-28, Q-T16 = A): the state before the task and the expected output, short human-written text, at most 280 characters per field in the label charset. There is no outcome key: the outcome of a run stays on the trace, on the host.

variant.description: The agent variant that these runs measure: a base agent version plus ONE diff (parent plan ADR-26). It is independent of the case: the same variant runs on many cases, and a case runs many variants. The executor block keeps its v1 meaning: executor.model_id is the model that ran (it equals variant.agent.model_id unless change_kind is model), executor.harness is a free display label, and executor.variant is the legacy structured-output run-profile flag. Neither is the agent variant.

agent.description: The BASE agent version (parent plan ADR-25, ADR-26): harness + model + rules + skills + configured tools, before the one diff. The field names match tma-pin/1, so the agent half of an origin pin is the baseline agent. The API derives agent_sha256 from this record (agentVersionSha256 in @itera/contracts).

harness.description: The agent harness, for example claude-code, codex or opencode.

harness_version.description: The version of the harness binary (for example 2.1.87); null when unknown.

harness_repo_sha.description: The commit of the harness configuration repository (skills, hooks, rules); null when the agent has none.

model_id.description: The base model, as a model-catalog id (lab/model).

rules_sha256.description: sha256 of the rules file as the harness loads it (CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md); null when there is none.

skills_sha256.description: sha256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON of the sorted list of the skill folder digests that the agent has (the tma-pin/1 skills_sha256 array); null when there are none.

mcp_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the manifest of the MCP servers and tools that the agent has CONFIGURED (not the environment servers of the case).

tools_sha256.description: sha256 of the configured built-in tools, permissions and scopes of the agent.

variant_sha256.description: sha256 of the ONE diff on the base agent (the changed prompt, rules, skill, retrieval, memory, model, configured tools, MCP servers, permissions, orchestration, limits or harness). For change_kind none, the sha256 of the empty string.

change_kind.description: The kind of the one diff. none = the base agent unchanged.

comparison.description: The crossing of this case and this variant. is_baseline = this variant is the baseline of the case (one per case; the first wins). A baseline has change_kind none and no prediction; any other variant has the digest of its written prediction against the baseline.

prediction_sha256.description: sha256 of the written prediction (this variant against the baseline, on this case); null for the baseline.

code_sha256.description: sha256 of the grader code (for a judge: of its prompt, rubric and params).

weight.description: The weight that the case declares for this grader.

decisive.description: false: a side signal (for example an uncalibrated judge).

proof.description: Optional, a property of the grader VERSION: its mutation proof (planted bugs caught, of planted). Every run that names the same version must send the same value.

calibration.description: Optional, a judge only, a property of the grader VERSION: the label counts and the 2x2 table of its test split. tp + fn + tn + fp = n_test and n_test <= n_labels. Counts and one date, no text.

realigned_at.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last re-alignment with the human labels.

note.description: Optional, a property of the grader VERSION: its version note (the label charset).

author.description: Optional, a property of the grader VERSION: the actor key of its author (a slug or a principal id, never an e-mail address).

reason_code.description: Optional, a property of this RESULT: the closed reason of a label (wrong_sha = checked the wrong SHA, no_check, partial, other).

labeler.description: Optional, a property of this RESULT: the actor key of the author of the label.

parts.description: The evaluator score parts (services/evaluator/src/score.ts SCORE_WEIGHTS), or null when the run was not graded.

tests.description: Test counts only (no test names, no output).

infra_ok.description: false when the run measured nothing (sandbox, network or provider fault).

trajectory.description: The structural trajectory of the run (tma-trajectory/1 or tma-trajectory/2, chosen by its format), or null when none was recorded.

infra_ok.description: false when the run measured nothing (sandbox, network or provider fault).

trajectory.description: The structural trajectory of the run (tma-trajectory/1 or tma-trajectory/2, chosen by its format), or null when none was recorded.

trajectory.description: The structural trajectory of the run (tma-trajectory/1 or tma-trajectory/2, chosen by its format), or null when none was recorded.
